<!--
=====================================================================
 THE HEALING COLLECTION — THANK-YOU PAGE FOR ELEMENTOR
 1. WordPress → Pages → Add New → title "Thank You" → Template: "Elementor Canvas".
 2. Edit with Elementor → drag in an "HTML" widget → paste ALL of this code → Publish.
 3. Find & Replace before publishing:
      YOUR_PIXEL_ID                         → your Meta Pixel ID (or delete the Meta script)
      G-XXXXXXXXXX                          → your Google Analytics ID (or delete the Google scripts)
      YOUR-EMAIL@hindsfeetglobal.com        → support.hindsfeetglobal@gmail.com (or your email)
      https://chat.whatsapp.com/YOUR-GROUP-LINK → your WhatsApp group link (or delete that box)
      https://YOUR-SALES-PAGE-LINK          → your Healing Collection sales page link
 4. Copy this page's link and paste it in Selar as the "redirect after purchase" link.
=====================================================================
-->
<!-- ================= SALES TRACKING =================
  1. Replace YOUR_PIXEL_ID with your Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Pixel ID.
  2. Replace G-XXXXXXXXXX with your Google Analytics 4 ID (or delete the Google part if you don't use it).
  3. Set this page as the "redirect after purchase" page in Selar, so ONLY buyers land here.
  A purchase is counted once per visitor, so refreshing the page does not count a second sale.
-->
<script>
  var HC_PRICE = 14.99, HC_CURRENCY = 'USD', HC_PRODUCT = 'The Healing Collection';
  var hcFirstVisit = true;
  try { hcFirstVisit = !localStorage.getItem('hc_purchase_tracked'); localStorage.setItem('hc_purchase_tracked', Date.now()); } catch (e) {}
</script>
<!-- Meta Pixel -->
<script>
  !function(f,b,e,v,n,t,s){if(f.fbq)return;n=f.fbq=function(){n.callMethod?n.callMethod.apply(n,arguments):n.queue.push(arguments)};
  if(!f._fbq)f._fbq=n;n.push=n;n.loaded=!0;n.version='2.0';n.queue=[];t=b.createElement(e);t.async=!0;
  t.src=v;s=b.getElementsByTagName(e)[0];s.parentNode.insertBefore(t,s)}(window,document,'script','https://connect.facebook.net/en_US/fbevents.js');
  fbq('init', 'YOUR_PIXEL_ID');
  fbq('track', 'PageView');
  if (hcFirstVisit) fbq('track', 'Purchase', { value: HC_PRICE, currency: HC_CURRENCY, content_name: HC_PRODUCT, content_type: 'product' });
</script>
<!-- Google Analytics 4 -->
<script async src="https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=G-XXXXXXXXXX"></script>
<script>
  window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || []; function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}
  gtag('js', new Date()); gtag('config', 'G-XXXXXXXXXX');
  if (hcFirstVisit) gtag('event', 'purchase', { transaction_id: 'hc-' + Date.now(), value: HC_PRICE, currency: HC_CURRENCY,
    items: [{ item_name: HC_PRODUCT, price: HC_PRICE, quantity: 1 }] });
</script>
<!-- ================= END SALES TRACKING ================= -->

<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,600;9..144,800&family=Nunito:wght@400;600;700;800;900&display=swap');

.hc { --green:#2E5E4E; --green2:#244B3F; --leaf:#6FA37A; --leafs:#E4EFE3; --terra:#C8643B; --gold:#E3A12F; --golds:#FBEFD3;
      --pink:#D9667A; --pinks:#FBE3E1; --cream:#FBF6EC; --sand:#F2E6D2; --ink:#2B2722; --muted:#6E665B;
      font-family:'Nunito',system-ui,sans-serif; color:var(--ink); background:var(--cream); line-height:1.6; font-size:18px; }
.hc * { box-sizing:border-box; }
.hc img { max-width:100%; display:block; }
.hc h1,.hc h2,.hc h3 { font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif; font-weight:800; line-height:1.12; margin:0 0 .5em; color:var(--green); }
.hc h1 { font-size:clamp(34px,6vw,58px); } .hc h2 { font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,40px); } .hc h3 { font-size:21px; }

.hc .kicker { display:inline-block; font-weight:900; font-size:14px; letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--terra); margin-bottom:12px; }
.hc .stripe { height:14px; background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold) 0 18px,var(--terra) 18px 52px,var(--cream) 52px 56px,var(--leaf) 56px 90px,var(--cream) 90px 94px,var(--green) 94px 128px); }
.hc .btn { display:inline-block; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#F0B23F,#DE931C); color:#2B1D05 !important; text-decoration:none; font-weight:900;
  font-size:19px; padding:16px 30px; border-radius:999px; box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(222,147,28,.35); }
.hc .btn.green { background:var(--green); color:#fff !important; box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(46,94,78,.3); }

.hc .hero { background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0,#FFF6E3 0,var(--cream) 50%,var(--sand) 100%); text-align:center; padding:56px 0; }
.hc .tick { width:96px; height:96px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--leaf); color:#fff; font-size:56px; font-weight:900; display:flex;
  align-items:center; justify-content:center; margin:0 auto 18px; box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(111,163,122,.4); }
.hc .hero .lead { font-size:21px; color:#3b352e; max-width:680px; margin:0 auto 26px; }
.hc .hero img.bundle { max-width:520px; margin:10px auto 0; border-radius:20px; box-shadow:0 20px 44px rgba(46,94,78,.2); }

.hc .dl { background:var(--green); color:#fff; }
.hc .dl h2 { color:#fff; }
.hc .dsteps { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:16px; margin-top:24px; }
.hc .dstep { background:rgba(255,255,255,.08); border-radius:18px; padding:22px; }
.hc .dstep b { display:flex; width:42px; height:42px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--gold); color:var(--green2); align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-size:22px; margin-bottom:10px; }
.hc .dstep p { margin:0; font-size:16.5px; color:#E6EFE8; }
.hc .dl .help { margin-top:22px; text-align:center; color:#DCE8DF; font-size:16px; }
.hc .dl .help a { color:var(--gold); font-weight:800; }

.hc .start { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:16px; margin-top:24px; }
.hc .scard { background:#fff; border-radius:20px; padding:22px 22px 22px 84px; position:relative; border:1px solid var(--sand); box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.05); }
.hc .scard .n { position:absolute; left:20px; top:22px; width:46px; height:46px; border-radius:14px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  color:#fff; font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-weight:800; font-size:22px; }
.hc .scard p { margin:0; font-size:16.5px; }

.hc .letter { background:var(--golds); }
.hc .letter .grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:220px 1fr; gap:34px; align-items:center; }
.hc .letter img { border-radius:50%; border:8px solid var(--gold); aspect-ratio:1; object-fit:cover; object-position:50% 20%; width:100%; }
.hc .letter .sig { font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-size:26px; color:var(--terra); font-weight:800; }

.hc .share .grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:16px; margin-top:22px; }
.hc .share .box { background:#fff; border-radius:20px; padding:26px; border:1px solid var(--sand); text-align:center; }
.hc .share .box p { font-size:16.5px; }

.hc footer { background:#1F3F35; color:#B9CBBF; font-size:13px; padding:26px 0; text-align:center; }
.hc footer p { margin:0 0 6px; }

@media (max-width:820px){
  .hc { font-size:17px; } .hc section { padding:48px 0; }
  .hc .dsteps,.hc .start,.hc .share .grid,.hc .letter .grid { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .hc .letter img { max-width:180px; margin:0 auto; }
  .hc .btn { width:100%; text-align:center; }
}
</style>
